title: Miniature stakeholder bucketizer - cross-functional availability snapshot
content:
Purpose: Quick, portable spreadsheet to bucket stakeholder availability and estimate spare capacity for one-off cross-functional asks (launch day support, canary monitoring, short-term spike coverage). Not exhaustive — designed for rapid decisions and handoffs.

Columns:
Stakeholder | Team | Timezone | Typical weekday availability (local) | On-call window | Estimated spare hours/week | Current sprint focus (top 1) | Known blockers | Risk if not covered (low/med/high) | Suggested backup

Rows:
Maya Lopez | Site Reliability (SRE) | PST | 09:30-17:30 | Pager M-F 18:00-08:00 | 6 | Incident triage automation | Infra quota requests backlog | high | Samir Desai
Ethan Brooks | Serving Runtime | PST | 08:00-16:00 | None | 8 | Kernel selector improvement | Waiting on quantization perf numbers | med | Kira Nguyen
Kira Nguyen | Product-Hosted API | EST | 10:00-18:00 | None | 10 | Rollout canary dashboard | API schema drift investigation | med | Product on-call rota
Samir Desai | Platform Engineering | CET | 09:00-17:00 | Rotating weekend oncall | 4 | Autoscale policy tuning | Capacity estimate mismatch for region eu-west | high | Platform backup engineer list
Riley Park | Observability | PST | 09:30-18:00 | Pager (alerts infra) | 5 | Latency sampling pipeline | Temporary backlog of traces | med | Maya Lopez
Anika Bose | Developer Experience | IST | 11:00-20:00 | None | 12 | SDK release prep | Waiting on CI image promotion | low | Ethan Brooks
Diego Alvarez | Solutions Engineering | PST | 07:30-15:30 | None | 3 | Customer pilot onboarding | Customer data onboarding delayed | high | SE float pool
Leah Morgan | Product-ops | MST | 09:00-17:00 | None | 7 | Launch checklist ownership | Multiple cross-team asks pending | med | Kira Nguyen
Omar Haddad | Security & Compliance | CET | 08:30-16:30 | Escalation-only oncall | 6 | KMS audit prep | External vendor sign-off slow | high | Security backup roster
Priya Singh | Customer Success | IST | 10:00-18:00 | None | 9 | Pilot feedback consolidation | N/A | low | Diego Alvarez

Quick interpretation notes:
- Highest immediate risk if SRE/platform/security not covered (Maya, Samir, Omar). These 3 have low spare hours.
- Best short-term surge capacity: Developer Experience (Anika) and Product-Hosted API (Kira) — both have 10+ spare hrs but depend on work priorities.
- Timezone overlaps: PST/ESt clustering creates a coverage window 10:00-16:00 PST for most Americas teams; CET/IST gaps need asynchronous handoffs.

Usage guidance:
- Use this sheet to decide who to loop for a 48-72h surge; prioritize high-risk roles first and assign backups.
- If a role is flagged high risk, trigger immediate 1:1 to confirm real availability and escalate to manager for reallocation.
- For cross-region launches, require one SRE + one Platform eng + one Observability contact explicitly assigned.

Raw notes / short todo (sticky):
- [ ] Confirm Samir weekend oncall dates for next 3 sprints (owner: Leah)
- [ ] Quick sync with Omar re: escalation-only oncall triage process (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Move Anika to SDK support board for launch week if CI image arrives before Wed (owner: Ethan)
- [ ] Publish 1-page surge assignment to #ops-handshake-thread (owner: Leah)

Last quick audit: 2027-03-18 by Maya L. — used this to staff a short 48h canary for new host routing; recommended backup assignments held to ensure low-blast rollout.

Publish surge assignment and expected coverage windows to Slack channel

Record actual burn vs estimated spare hours after surge for calibration
